ChatWechat invokes the vendored JavaScript/Emscripten wrapper in a short-lived local
Node.js process. No network access is performed. The original package SHA-512
integrity prefix published by npm is mXPwLRtZxrYV3; the vendored wasm size is 234626 bytes.
Vendored silk.wasm SHA-256: 88152af59af535b8056ac806710824b2259a361027451b494f175f48fb39c807
